
    <section id="inventory" class="section inventory-section">

def write_text(rel: str, text: str) -> None:
    p = ROOT / rel
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')


def main() -> None:
    cover_path = ROOT / COVER_REL
    if not cover_path.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f'Approved cover missing: {COVER_REL}')
    cover = cover_path.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(cover).hexdigest() != COVER_SHA256:
        raise SystemExit('Approved cover SHA256 mismatch')
    with Image.open(cover_path) as im:
        if im.size != (1122, 1402):
            raise SystemExit(f'Unexpected approved cover dimensions: {im.size}')

    registry_path = ROOT / 'episodes.json'
    registry = json.loads(registry_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    episodes = [e for e in registry['episodes'] if e.get('number') != 50]
    episodes.append(EPISODE)
    episodes.sort(key=lambda e: e['number'], reverse=True)
    registry['schemaVersion'] = 2
    registry['episodes'] = episodes
    registry_path.write_text(json.dumps(registry, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')), encoding='utf-8')

    collections_path = ROOT / 'collections.json'
    collections = json.loads(collections_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    for coll in collections.get('collections', []):
        if coll.get('slug') == 'impossible-structures':
            nums = [n for n in coll['episodes'] if n != 50]
            # Keep the existing editorial sequence; place Bifrost directly after the most recent structure.
            coll['episodes'] = ([nums[0], 50] + nums[1:]) if nums else [50]
        elif coll.get('slug') == 'legendary-engineering':
            nums = [n for n in coll['episodes'] if n != 50]
            insert_at = next((i for i, n in enumerate(nums) if n < 50), len(nums))
            coll['episodes'] = nums[:insert_at] + [50] + nums[insert_at:]
    collections_path.write_text(json.dumps(collections, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

    write_text('assets/images/episode-graphics/ep50-inventory-map.svg', INVENTORY_MAP)
    write_text('assets/images/episode-graphics/ep50-technical-plate.svg', TECHNICAL_PLATE)
    write_text('assets/images/episode-graphics/ep50-hotspot-breakdown.svg', HOTSPOT)
    write_text('episodes/bifrost.html', HTML)

    # Hard publication guards before synchronization.
    if any('pdf' in e for e in registry['episodes']):
        raise SystemExit('Registry contains a forbidden pdf field')
    html = (ROOT / 'episodes/bifrost.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    if 'assets/pdf/episodes/' in html or 'Raw text' in html or 'Download episode PDF' in html:
        raise SystemExit('Forbidden source-PDF/raw-text control detected')
    print('Episode 50 source files prepared; approved cover exact SHA verified.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
